Best beach bar club
Sep 2026 • Solo
As a local guide on Phu Quoc Island, this is the best beach bar I regularly visit and love introducing my friends to.
It has a very peaceful vibe, making it perfect for breakfast or lunch, or just hanging out by the swimming pool with a few cocktails. The view here is absolutely stunning, featuring the pool set against the ocean backdrop, swaying coconut trees, and a lovely path that's great for walking or biking.
I can't recommend it enough! The staff here are exceptionally friendly and helpful. A special thank you to Hao for helping me with drinks, towels, and overall making every visit so enjoyable.
On top of all that, they offer a free-flow deal during certain hours. I've enjoyed the free-flow cocktails before, and this morning I tried the healthy fresh fruit juice option. At 190,000 VND, the price is unbeatable—you truly won't find better quality or a better deal anywhere else!

Written September 19, 2026
Beach Club Sailing Club
Thank you so much for such a detailed and heartfelt review! We’re truly delighted to know that the Beach Club has become one of your favorite places to visit and a spot you enjoy introducing to your friends.

It’s wonderful to hear that you enjoy our peaceful atmosphere, beachfront views, pool, and the fresh and relaxing experience we aim to create. We’re especially happy that you enjoyed our free-flow offerings, from cocktails to the healthy fresh fruit juices.

A special thank you for recognizing Hao’s friendly and attentive service. We’ll be sure to share your kind words with him. Your support and recommendation mean a great deal to our entire team, and we look forward to welcoming you and your friends back again soon! 🌴🌊🍹
